title: SEC EDGAR Signals
description: Choose one workflow. Funding leads is the default and returns one dataset row per qualified company.

action.title: What do you want to find?
action.description: Funding leads finds private companies that recently reported a capital raise. The other workflows cover insider trades, public-company fundamentals, and 10-K/10-Q/8-K search.

days_back.title: Lookback window
days_back.sectionDescription: Used by funding leads and filing search. The default Store test requests only 10 recent records for a quick first run.
days_back.description: Search from today back through this many calendar days.

limit.title: Maximum results
limit.description: Hard maximum: the Actor never returns more rows than this value.

industries.title: Industries to include
industries.sectionDescription: Optional Form D filters. Leave lists empty and amounts at 0 to accept all operating-company leads.
industries.description: Optional SEC industry names or partial matches, one per line; for example Other Technology, Health Care, Oil and Gas, or Banking.

states.title: US states to include
states.description: Optional two-letter codes or full state names, one per line. Leave empty for every location.

min_amount_raised_usd.title: Minimum amount raised
min_amount_raised_usd.description: Require at least this much in Form D totalAmountSold. 0 disables the filter.

max_amount_raised_usd.title: Maximum amount raised
max_amount_raised_usd.description: Exclude raises above this amount. 0 means no upper limit.

only_with_phone.title: Only leads with a phone number
only_with_phone.description: Return only filings that disclose an issuer phone number.

only_with_executives.title: Only leads with a named executive
only_with_executives.description: Return only filings with at least one disclosed related person or signatory.

exclude_funds.title: Exclude investment funds
exclude_funds.description: Remove pooled investment funds and fund entities; recommended for B2B prospecting.

exclude_real_estate.title: Exclude property SPVs
exclude_real_estate.description: Remove real-estate holding vehicles and property-specific LLCs; recommended for operating-company leads.

include_amendments.title: Include Form D amendments
include_amendments.description: Also search D/A amendments. Disabled by default so a changed filing is not mistaken for a brand-new raise.

symbol.title: Ticker or CIK
symbol.sectionDescription: Used only by the snapshot and insider-transactions workflows.
symbol.description: US public-company ticker such as NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, or a numeric SEC CIK.

keyword.title: Filing-search keyword
keyword.sectionDescription: Used by filing_search. It can also be used as an optional full-text filter for funding_leads.
keyword.description: Word or phrase to find in SEC filings, for example cybersecurity, bankruptcy, or material weakness.

forms.title: SEC form types
forms.description: Form types for filing_search, one per line. Common values: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, S-1, DEF 14A.
